requirements.definition: X has POINTER or TARGET; allocatable X is allocated; pointer X is associated.

pending.C_LOC-X-pointer-or-target: Guarded positive source control first requires C_INT > 0, declares INTEGER(C_INT), TARGET :: x=17_C_INT and calls C_LOC(x); mutation removes TARGET and claims no diagnostic facet.

accounting.rationale: Description defines the purpose of C_LOC.
Argument restrictions are split by attribute/state, type eligibility, array/character exclusions, and coindexed exclusion.
Type eligibility restrictions for C_LOC X.
Result value cases and C_F_POINTER round-trip effect are split.
Interoperable target companion C address value.
Round trip through C_F_POINTER has pointer-assignment effect.

review_rationale: Source registration for 18.2.3.4-18.2.3.9: C_F_PROCPOINTER, C_F_STRPOINTER, C_FUNLOC, C_LOC, C_SIZEOF and F_C_STRING (batch241). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; pointer conversions are round-tripped to the same target, and procedure pointers are exercised from both C_FUNLOC and C. Source accounting only.
